title: World Cup 2026 & AC Milan Coaching Drama: Betting…
excerpt: Iran's Taremi says tension 'undermines joy', while AC Milan gets a new boss. What does this mean for African bettors? We break it down.
body:
The 2026 World Cup is underway, and African football fans are glued to their screens, cheering on their favorite teams. Meanwhile, AC Milan has made some major changes, hiring Ruben Amorim as their new head coach. Let's dive into the implications of these developments for African bettors.

Firstly, let's look at the World Cup. Iran's Taremi has expressed his concern about the tension surrounding the tournament. In an interview, he said, "Sometimes a team needs a player to have some standout performance to change the mood. That's what we're looking for." This is music to the ears of African bettors, who love a good underdog story. With Iran's opening game against the United States, odds are favoring the Americans to win (Bet9ja: 1.40, Sportybet: 1.42). However, given Taremi's words, we might see a surprise or two.

Moving on to AC Milan, the Italian giants have hired Ruben Amorim as their new head coach. This is a significant development, not just for AC Milan but also for Manchester United, who will not need to pay the full £16.7m compensation for Amorim's departure. African bettors may be interested in the impact of Amorim's appointment on AC Milan's next few games. With odds currently favoring AC Milan to win their next match (Bet9ja: 1.30, Sportybet: 1.32), we might see some value in the draw or even an upset.

The VAR controversy continues to rage on, with Fifa seeking an explanation over a hand gesture made by video assistant referee Shaun Evans during Germany's 7-1 win over Curacao. This could have significant implications for betting markets, particularly in games involving Germany. African bettors should keep an eye on the developments and adjust their bets accordingly.

In other news, Marc Cucurella has officially joined Real Madrid, and his former Chelsea teammate, Fernandez, might follow suit. This could have an impact on the Europa League, with Real Madrid looking to strengthen their squad. African bettors may be interested in the odds for Real Madrid's next Europa League match (Bet9ja: 1.20, Sportybet: 1.22).

As African football fans continue to cheer on their favorite teams, it's essential to remember the importance of responsible betting. Don't chase losses, and set a budget for yourself. With the World Cup and AC Milan's coaching drama, there are plenty of opportunities to make informed bets.
